notes.title: ANNIVERSARY SALES! 4 years of making adult games!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/39755770/17bf3fc8f1e2048ef50c8dc4e2f149f007dccb8e.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,
We are thrilled to start a big sale on all our games to celebrate 4 years of game making with your support and energy, [b]-33% to -69%[/b] on all our games and DLCs (including Sexts and Meet My Teacher!).

You can check all our games directly on the studio page: 
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/NSFW18Games

We also recently made a "studio trailer" to present our games in a safe way (to be on Youtube !):
https://youtu.be/ojVboMyJgIs

Also don't hesitate to wishlist our upcoming projects including Meet My Stepmoms, our new typing free to play:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833130/Meet_My_Stepmoms/
Or Secret Kinks with the new demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391670/Secret_Kinks/
And Soy Supremacy, a bright visual novel planned for the end of the year:

notes.title: SECRET KINKS: DEMO AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39755770/65f767261d3dab6ad8d768abb226c05d84c9ef21.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]Hello Lewd Tribe,[/h1][/b]
I'm glad to announce (after a very long time and a lot of delay) the demo of Secret Kinks, a game made as a team with 4 other people.
It's the first time I make a project with a lot of people, I hope you will enjoy it and send me your feedback so we can improve the game planned for Q3 2025 !

[list][*] Check the Steam page.
[*] Play the demo!
[*] Wishlist the game if you like it! 
[/list]

The demo is quiet short but I will make the week 2 available in the demo as well when it will be ready (soon™️).
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3391670/Secret_Kinks/

notes.title: New Free To Play Coming September
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/39755770/44904c59b079d60487eddfa5fc619118ccfcaf4a.jpg[/img]
[h1]Hello everyone, [/h1]

You have been many to vote for our next typing game on Patreon ([url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/vote-for-next-my-103928774]public vote[/url]), thank you so much!

With twice more votes than the other possibilities, STEPMOM was clearly your favorite theme! I worked during the last 3 months on it and we are good to start a close early access next week for our special supporters!

In the meantime, Meet My Stepmoms page is now online with some spicy screenshots and the presentation of the 4 women, wishlist now to support them and [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/nsfw18games/membership]join us on Patreon[/url] to get an exclusive early access during the summer, exclusive 18+ content and FREE Steam keys for the DLCs! <3
